evals.prompt: Create src/app/user-card.component.ts: a user-card component that shows a user's name and email and emits a selected event when clicked.
evals.expected_output: The agent writes a standalone component with function-based input and output, OnPush change detection, no decorators and no NgModule.

checks.name: no decorators or NgModule, and no standalone flag

evals.prompt: In src/app/user-detail.component.ts, load the user from UserService every time userId changes. Also stream live updates from UserService.watch() and stop listening when the component is destroyed.
evals.expected_output: The agent watches the input signal with an effect instead of using ngOnInit or ngOnChanges, and ends the watch() subscription with takeUntilDestroyed and a DestroyRef.

evals.prompt: Create src/app/orders-list.component.ts, which renders a list of orders. Show a total only when there are orders, and show an empty state when there are none.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses @for with a track on a unique property, @empty for the zero-items case, and @if for the conditional total.

evals.prompt: Review src/app/legacy-list.component.ts before I merge it, and fix whatever breaks our conventions.
evals.expected_output: The agent fixes each convention violation in the file.
